pendingActions.workDescription: I completed the roof inspection and everything looks good. I looked for existing and potential leaks and checked for damaged or missing shingles. I inspected the flashing and the seals around the pipes, vents and other roof penetrations. I checked the high gutters and downspouts for blockages and made sure the drainage system is working. Nothing needed immediate repair to prevent winter weather damage. Job complete.

Building Exterior > Building/Structure Repair & Maintenance > Roof
Inspection
Description: “Please complete a roofing inspection to assess overall condition. Please identify existing and/or potential leaks, damaged or missing shingles/tiles/membrane, inspect flashing and seals around penetrations, examine high gutters (over 8’) and downspouts for blockages, and evaluate drainage systems. Address any findings requiring immediate repair to prevent winter weather damage. Please submit a quote for any work over $500.”
